selection_reasoning: The 'find purple_bed' task is a straightforward observation/navigation task that requires the agent to locate a purple bed placed in the Minecraft scene. It is easily verifiable (the agent must be near the bed and looking at it), doesn't require deep Minecraft domain knowledge, and can be set up in a scene with clear visual landmarks. As a single atomic task, no dependency edges are needed.

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task — the player must navigate to the purple bed on the wooden platform and visually confirm it. The bed head is at spawn-relative (8, 1, 8). max_distance=5 ensures meaningful navigation (the bed is ~11 blocks diagonally from spawn, so the player must walk at least 6 blocks toward it). facing_tolerance=60 degrees ensures the player is actually looking toward the bed, confirming visual observation rather than just passing nearby.

scene_description: An open wooden platform (5x5 oak planks) with a 1-block-high oak log border, located 6-10 blocks from spawn. Inside the platform sits a purple bed (facing south), a crafting table, and a chest. The platform has an opening on the north side for easy entry. The open-top design ensures the purple bed is visible from outside the enclosure.
task_text: Find the purple bed on the nearby wooden platform.
design_notes: The platform is at ~6-10 blocks from spawn in the +X/+Z direction. The purple bed occupies two blocks: head at (~8,~1,~8) and foot at (~8,~1,~9). The 1-block oak log border creates a visual landmark without obstructing the view of the bed. An opening at (~8,~1,~6) on the north wall allows entry. The grass ground and cleared air ensure clean sightlines. The crafting table and chest add visual interest and make the platform look like a lived-in camp.
